page.description: Ready-made scripts for classes, trainings and meetings. Pick one, PulseStage creates a draft session with the questions, and you adjust whatever you like.
page.fromScratchDescription: An empty session, to build the questions your way.
page.editHint: The examples are meant to be replaced: everything stays editable in the draft, and nothing reaches the audience until you start.

errors.createFailed: Couldn't create the session from the template.

classOpener.name: Class opener
classOpener.summary: Break the ice, find out what the class already knows and agree on what to expect.
classOpener.sessionDescription: Welcome, prior knowledge and the class's expectations.

welcome.title: Welcome! Today's topic is…
welcome.body:
Replace this text with the topic and goal of the class.

- Join with the QR code or the code on the screen
- Answer honestly: there are no wrong answers here

mood.title: In one word: how are you arriving today?

prior.title: How much do you already know about today's topic?

warmup.title: Quick guess: how many countries are members of the UN?

expect.title: What do you want to know by the end of this class?

quizReview.name: Quiz review
quizReview.summary: Review the content by playing in teams: timed quiz, typed answer and a number guess.
quizReview.sessionDescription: Content review as a game, with a team ranking.

rules.title: How the review works
rules.body:
- Each question has a time limit
- Faster correct answers earn more points
- At the end, the ranking shows the winning team

Replace the sample questions with your own content.

prime.title: Which of these numbers is prime?

planet.title: What is the largest planet in the Solar System?

water.title: What is the chemical formula for water?

moon.title: In what year did humans first walk on the Moon?

ready.title: How ready do you feel for the exam?

projectRetro.name: Project retrospective
projectRetro.summary: Close a cycle with the team: mood, what worked, what to improve and where to put energy next.
projectRetro.sessionDescription: Cycle retrospective: what to keep, what to improve and next priorities.

cycle.title: From 1 to 5, how was this cycle for you?

word.title: One word that sums up the project

keep.title: What worked well and should we keep?

improve.title: What got in the way and can we improve?

focus.title: Split 100 points: where should we invest next cycle?

corporateTraining.name: Corporate training
corporateTraining.summary: A diagnosis by department, a learning check and priorities for the next meeting.
corporateTraining.sessionDescription: Training with an initial diagnosis, a learning check and questions.

area.title: Which department do you work in?

before.title: Before we start: how well do you know the topic?

phishing.title: A suspicious email asks for your password. What do you do?

options.report: Tell the security team and delete it

topics.title: Rank the topics you want to go deeper on

doubts.title: What question do you still have?

planning.name: Planning (2×2 and 100 points)
planning.summary: Prioritize initiatives with the effort × impact matrix and a 100-point split.
planning.sessionDescription: Prioritizing initiatives by effort, impact and points.

intro.title: Let's prioritize together
intro.body:
Replace the sample initiatives with yours.

- First, everyone places the initiatives by effort and impact
- Then, everyone splits 100 points among them
- Finally, we choose where to start

matrix.title: Place each initiative by effort and impact

start.title: Which two do we start right away?

selfPacedSurvey.name: Self-paced survey
selfPacedSurvey.summary: A questionnaire everyone answers at their own pace, with no presenter: great for end of term or a team pulse check.
selfPacedSurvey.sessionDescription: A survey answered at each person's own pace.

intro.title: Thanks for taking part!
intro.body: Answer at your own pace, on your phone. It only takes a few minutes.

values.title: What do you value most? (up to 3)

recommend.title: From 0 to 10, how likely are you to recommend it to a friend?

change.title: If you could change one thing, what would it be?
